name: SailPoint Identity Security Administrator
aligned: Aligned to the SailPoint Certified Identity Security Administrator exam prep guide
notice: Independent study project, not affiliated with or endorsed by SailPoint Technologies, Inc. SailPoint, Identity Security Cloud and IdentityNow are trademarks of SailPoint Technologies, Inc.; other names are trademarks of their owners.
weights_note: SailPoint's exam prep guide lists the sections and objectives but no weights. Practice exams weight each section by its number of official objectives (9 / 3 / 7 / 5 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 5); PROJECTED. The grouping of official objectives into course objectives is this course's own.

objectives.1.1: Search queries and scheduled search reports
objectives.1.2: REST API, tenant authentication and security administration
objectives.1.3: Monitoring, event triggers, workflows and configuration backup
objectives.3.1: Identity profiles and their authentication options
objectives.3.3: Lifecycle states and the cloud lifecycle state attribute
objectives.4.1: How provisioning is triggered, its components and channels
objectives.5.1: User levels and the types of access SailPoint supports
objectives.5.2: Entitlements, roles, automated assignment and access troubleshooting
objectives.6.1: Access requests, approvals and work reassignment

pass_label: SailPoint grades pass or fail; this course uses 70 % as a readiness target
exam_questions_note: Up to 74 discrete option multiple choice (DOMC) questions, up to 120 minutes, online proctored; the exam ends early once enough answers decide the result (SailPoint exam prep guide, checked 2026-11-06). Practice exams use 74 questions in 120 minutes.

exam_target.name: SailPoint Certified Identity Security Administrator
exam_target.note: No retirement date is announced. Identity Security Cloud. Up to 74 DOMC questions, up to 120 minutes, online proctored, pass or fail; USD 400; 6 months of hands-on experience recommended (SailPoint, checked 2026-11-06).
